name: Debit Authorisation Details
definition: Provides the reason for requesting a debit authorisation as well as the amount of the requested debit.

AmountToDebit.name: Amount To Debit
AmountToDebit.definition: Amount of money to be moved between the debtor and creditor, before deduction of charges, expressed in the currency as ordered by the initiating party.

ValueDateToDebit.name: Value Date To Debit
ValueDateToDebit.definition: Value date for debiting the amount.
